convert_grounding_dino_checkpoint: convert a GroundingDINO checkpoint from the original repository to HuggingFace format
get_grounding_dino_config: get a GroundingDinoConfig for a given model name such as grounding-dino-tiny or grounding-dino-base
create_rename_keys: create key renaming mappings to transform an original GroundingDINO state dict to HuggingFace naming
read_in_q_k_v_encoder: split concatenated query-key-value weight matrices into separate tensors for the vision backbone encoder
read_in_q_k_v_decoder: split concatenated query-key-value weight matrices into separate tensors for the decoder layers
